title: The Bohr Phenomenon for Close-to-Convex Harmonic Mappings
summary: The classical Bohr inequality states that if $f(z)=\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} a_n z^n$ is analytic and $|f(z)| -M + |zg''(z)|, \; z \in \mathbb{D}, \; M > 0 \} \] \[ \mathcal{W}_{\mathcal{H}_0}(α,β) := \{ f \in \mathcal{H}_0 : \text{Re}(h'(z) + αzh''(z) - β) > |g'(z) + αzg''(z)|, \; z \in \mathbb{D} \} \] where $α\ge 0$, $β< 1$.
